component.name: Phosrack
component.summary: A compact modular music rack for Spotify
Un rack musical compacto y modular para Spotify
Un rack musical compact et modulaire pour Spotify

description.p: Phosrack is a desktop Spotify controller inspired by classic modular media players. Its compact rack combines playback, search, queue and library views with an original live visualizer for your local audio output.

Connect your own Spotify account with browser authorization. The bundled public application ID remains subject to Spotify Premium and development-mode access restrictions. Spotify plays on an existing Spotify device. The local visualizer follows your system output.
The local ten-band equalizer offers editable presets and preamp control. A fullscreen visualizer displays current and upcoming track information.
